name: tf_metadata
title: TF metadata (comprehensive)
description: One row per unique TF target gene in the perturb-seq library. Joins target_genes.tsv with the IGVF GTF, HGNC complete set, Lambert et al. 2018, and JASPAR CORE (human).

fields.name: gene_symbol
fields.description: Original gene symbol as it appears in the target list (primary key).

fields.name: hgnc_approved_symbol
fields.description: Current approved symbol after alias resolution. Equals gene_symbol for ~98% of rows; differs for deprecated names (e.g. T -> TBXT, NOV -> CCN3).

fields.name: n_promoters_in_target_library
fields.description: Number of promoter rows for this gene in the library (counts both named rows and Gene=NaN continuation rows).

fields.name: in_lambert_2018
fields.description: Whether the gene appears in the Lambert 2018 database (matched first by Ensembl ID, then by symbol).

fields.name: lambert_2018_is_tf
fields.description: Lambert 'Is TF?' flag (Yes / No / In progress).

fields.name: in_jaspar_core
fields.description: Whether the gene has any human JASPAR CORE entry (matched by approved or original symbol).

sources.name: target_genes.tsv
sources.purpose: Target gene list + per-gene promoter-row count (continuation rows with NaN Gene are recovered via the promoter-ID prefix).

sources.name: IGVF GTF
sources.purpose: Primary gene_name -> ensembl_gene_id map; also exposes hgnc_id for ID-based fallback.

sources.name: HGNC complete set
sources.purpose: Authoritative prev_symbol / alias_symbol -> approved symbol resolver.

sources.name: Lambert et al. 2018
sources.purpose: Curated human TF list, DBD, TF-assessment. Referer header required for download.

sources.name: JASPAR CORE
sources.purpose: TF class / family / matrix IDs / UniProt (filtered to tax_id='9606').

notes: Coverage at last run: 1983 unique target genes; 1981 with Ensembl ID; 1868 in Lambert 2018; 774 with a JASPAR human entry.
Two readthrough fusions (APITD1-CORT, MEF2BNB-MEF2B) resolve to fusion ENSGs via HGNC.
